share_definitions: per quarter: sum dt / sum dQ (signed, as the task states) and sum dt / |sum dQ|. Overall: share_overall = (t_sum(287) - t_sum(187)) / |Q(287) - Q(187)| (signed dt over |dQ|).
verdict_rule: Applied to the signed share_overall: share_overall < 0.20 -> 'H_pf-gap minor'; share_overall >= 0.40 -> 'gross creep is the wrong quantity'; otherwise -> 'mixed'. |share_overall| reported beside.

out_of_sample_fit.primary: on the three quarter means m_1..m_3 (Q1..Q3) of a series: m_j = a * exp(b * (j - 1)), least squares on log(m_j / sgn) where all three m_j share sign sgn (else 'not fittable in log form'); predict m_4; report error = observed m_4 - predicted and relative error. Done for dQ and for dQ_cc.
out_of_sample_fit.secondary: per-cycle values on 188-262: y(k) = a * exp(b * (k - 188)), scipy.optimize.curve_fit, initial guess from the primary fit (or a = mean, b = 0); predict the mean over 263-287; report the same errors.

dual_path: per cycle k (2..287, reported 88..287): D(k) = || y(k) - y(k-1) ||_2 over all 1728 pf entries (p and q), y = lambda_pf_dso / dso_base_mva (interface_duals_per_cycle.jsonl; the Boyd y of shared_resources_planning.get_admm_boyd_residual_metrics); E(k) = rho_pf(k) * || r_pf(k) ||, r_pf = the Boyd pf r (creep_diagnostic boyd.pf.r), rho_pf = the entry rho_pf in force (pf_entry_stride). The DSO dual update (shared_resources_planning.py _update_interface_power_flow_variables) is lambda_dso += rho_pf_dso * (x_dso - z_tso) / interface_rating * dso_s_base, so a standard dual path gives D(k)/E(k) = 1 and per-entry dy = rho * r. Report ratio per cycle, quarter means, max per-entry |dy - rho r|, and the OLS slope of the ratio in k over 88-287 and 188-287.
